newton.note: Hardcoded per-sample arguments to MnaCircuitEngine::processSample() inside PowerAmpCircuit::processSample(); not runtime-configurable. Recorded here so a change to those literals is a visible, reviewable diff against this file rather than a silent behavior change.

default.note: PowerAmpCircuit exposes no setControls()/knob API today (see include/guitardsp/circuit/PowerAmpCircuit.h) -- it is a fixed self-biased single-ended EL34 stage. Only one variant exists; there is no 'mid'/'full' pair to generate.
